overview_description.description:
TRAC is an on-demand race timing and analysis solution for road, cross country, and trail races. The solution can be access on iOS, Android, and web platforms.

TRAC was founded by Griffin Kelly and Elliot Hevel in 2014 and is based in Evanston, Illinois.
